# Daily Report — 2026-08-06

## Task Completed
Added `get_flow_execution` tool (GET sys_flow_context/{sys_id}) to complete the Flow
Designer execution lifecycle alongside the existing `trigger_flow` and
`list_flow_executions` tools.

Key details:
- Fetches a single `sys_flow_context` record by sys_id
- Returns 13 normalised fields: state, flow (display value), started_on, ended_on,
  error, run_as, trigger_type, trigger, context_parameters, created_on, updated_on
- 404 guard (status code 404 → clean "not found" message)
- Empty-result guard (HTTP 200 with empty body → clean "not found" message)
- Reference dict fields (`flow`, `run_as`) normalised to display_value or value
- Registered in `platform_developer` and `full` tool packages

Files changed:
- `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/flow_tools.py` — added `GetFlowExecutionParams` model and
  `get_flow_execution` function
- `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/__init__.py` — imported and exported `get_flow_execution`
- `src/servicenow_mcp/utils/tool_utils.py` — imported params + function; added handler
  registration entry
- `config/tool_packages.yaml` — added to `platform_developer` and `full` packages
- `tests/test_flow_tools.py` — 12 new tests covering happy path, 404, empty result,
  missing required param, network error, string/dict ref fields, optional-field
  defaults, error state, and HTTP 500
